crossRefs.note: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you graze your flock, where you rest them at noon; for why should I be as one…
If you don’t know, most beautiful among women, follow the tracks of the sheep. Graze your young goats beside the…
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t…

translations.web: So you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
translations.bsb: So you will follow in the ways of the good, and keep to the paths of the righteous.
translations.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
translations.asv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.
